title: Unkey Identity
description: An identity in the Unkey platform that groups multiple API keys under a single external user or organization, enabling shared rate limits and analytics.

workspaceId.description: ID of the workspace this identity belongs to

externalId.description: External identifier from the integrating application (user ID, org ID, etc.)

meta.description: Arbitrary metadata associated with the identity

ratelimits.description: Rate limit configurations shared across all keys in this identity

createdAt.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the identity was created

updatedAt.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when the identity was last updated
